expectedText: How was your interview at the neighborhood museum on Friday, Rina? It was interesting. I went at eleven in the morning and spoke to the manager of the events department. What position did you apply for? The vacancy was for a weekend workshop assistant. I sent the application on Wednesday. The employer wanted someone to help visitors find materials. Did you give an example of your experience? Yes. I described a garden event where my colleague and I worked as a team. I showed a certificate from a short art course as one qualification. I also brought a copy of my application for the manager. What did they ask about? They asked how I would help a customer who arrived late. I said I would listen, check the task list and ask an employee if I was unsure.
